content_sections.heading: IIEST Shibpur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIEST Shibpur Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate-I position at IIEST Shibpur is scheduled for 09 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech degree with a CGPA of 7.0 and have at least 1 year of experience in Analog and Mixed Signal Design.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position at IIEST Shibpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IIEST Shibpur office, Howrah, West Bengal, PIN 711103.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position is a contractual job.
